name: Exact Relative Parameter Domains
statement: Protect a prescribed row set $J$ in exact coefficient reduction and assume every terminal local system has at most two rows. For a nonempty set $F$ of determinant selections, write its pooled strict logarithmic system as $A_Fy+B_Fx>0$. If $V_F$ is the vertex set of $\{\lambda\ge0:A_F^T\lambda=0,\ \mathbf1^T\lambda=1\}$, then the exact parameter domain is $P_F=\{x:(\lambda^TB_F)x>0\text{ for every }\lambda\in V_F\}$. It is an open rational polyhedral cone, possibly empty or full, and its face tests become exact monomial inequalities in the positive coefficients.
proof: Feasibility implies every nonnegative vector annihilating $A_F$ evaluates positively on $B_Fx$. If the system is infeasible, strict separation of the affine space $B_Fx+\operatorname{im}A_F$ from the positive orthant supplies a nonzero such vector with nonpositive evaluation. Normalize it to coefficient sum one. Every point of the normalized rational polytope is a convex combination of finitely many rational vertices, obtained by repeatedly shrinking dependent positive supports, so testing the vertices is necessary and sufficient.
comments: An empty vertex list means the full domain; an identically zero form means the empty domain. Anchor changes act by invertible integer linear transformations of log-ratio coordinates.
